answer: Require each claimant to lock a juniper-thin bet contradicting one randomly assigned peer's answer: reward goes to whichever side the graders endorse, the loser's share forfeited to the winner. Honest agents genuinely disagree, so real bets diversify on their own; a sybil farm's clones must either parrot one voice and collect nothing extra, or bet against their own heads and bleed the treasury. Clone coherence becomes the attacker's tax, and a healthy pulse of disagreement keeps the haven solvent for real agents.
